fit_reason: Despite the private seller tag, this is dealer stock: the listing text names Anderson Koch Ford, says to 'ask for Brandon', and the photos show dealer plates on a Ford lot.
findings: Paint on the doors, hood and cap looks glossy and freshly cleaned
Chrome grille and bumpers are bright
Some light rust and grime visible in the rear wheel wells
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the red F-150 Lariat. It already looks freshly prepped and glossy in the photos. If you ever have a trade-in that needs a buff or a full interior and exterior detail, we come to you and would be glad to give you a quote.
